say:1:1621503201:1.text: I don't get it! Why do cats always support those with a wicked streak? Meowris is certainly not the great leader you make her out to be!
say:1:1621503201:1.source_cn: 你们这群猫就爱崇拜那种邪恶的头头！她绝对不是你们说的那样好！

say:2:1621503202:1.text: She was once a notorious troublemaker at the Serene Lyceum!
say:2:1621503202:1.source_cn: 她可是当年莱希拉姆出了名的问题奶猫！

say:3:1621503203:1.text: Knocking over teacups, chewing books, and luring other animals into traps... It would take days just to recount all her pranks!
say:3:1621503203:1.source_cn: 推茶杯、咬书角、把别的动物引进陷阱……她的恶作剧能写满...

say:4:1621503204:1.text: S-She did something really terrible to me <style="highlight">...</style>!
